problem_statement: themesberg/flowbite-admin-dashboard is an admin dashboard built with Hugo, webpack, and Tailwind CSS (Flowbite), with a fixed sidebar (Dashboard, Layouts, CRUD -> Products/Users, Settings, Pages, Authentication) and CRUD pages backed by Hugo data files. Add a genre-native Filter products control to the Products table page: a technology chip row above the products table with chips (All, Angular, React JS, Vue.js, Svelte) and a live result readout 'Showing N of 24 . <Technology>' over the 24-row product table. Clicking a technology chip must filter the table rows to that technology AND recompute the readout (e.g. 'Showing 6 of 24 . Vue.js'). The Filter products chip strip also appears as a compact teaser on the Users and Settings pages so technology browsing stays continuous across the dashboard. The chip row must be responsive (wrap on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow) and the products table must stay a tidy legible table with readable row text and active-chip contrast. Keep the Flowbite light theme, blue (#1a56db) accent, and sidebar intact.
required_content: The Products page shows a 'Filter products' technology chip row with five chips and a live 'Showing N of 24 . <Technology>' readout above the 24-row products table.
Clicking a technology chip filters the table rows AND updates the readout; clicking Vue.js yields 'Showing 6 of 24 . Vue.js'.
The Filter products chip strip appears as a compact teaser on the Users and Settings pages (cross-page continuity).
At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow; the products table stays a tidy legible table on desktop with readable active-chip contrast.
Each table row shows its product name, technology, price, and discount.
No new JavaScript console errors or failed same-origin network requests are introduced on any captured page.
design_constraints: Preserve the Flowbite admin light theme, blue (#1a56db) accent, and fixed sidebar navigation.
The Filter products chip row must ride above the products table it controls (Products page) and as a compact teaser on Users + Settings; do not make it a separate page or hero banner.
The technology chip row must be responsive (wrap / flexible chips), not a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the mobile viewport.
The products table rows must stay a tidy legible table; rows must not shingle or overlap via negative margins, and row text / active-chip text must stay legible (no near-black-on-dark).
Clicking a chip must recompute the readout from the active technology; a frozen/stale readout that never updates is a defect.
Only the Filter-products markup/stylesheet/script and its teaser presence change between legs; the shared theme, sidebar, and table columns stay the same.
state_constraints: desktop_products captures the Products page at 1440px: the Filter products chip row renders five technology chips in one tidy responsive row above a legible products table, active chip readable, readout 'Showing 24 of 24 . All'.
mobile_products captures the same page at 390px: the responsive chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow (a fixed-width nowrap chip row would push the document wider than the viewport).
desktop_users and desktop_settings show the compact Filter products teaser (cross-page continuity); desktop_dashboard captures the dashboard home (shared theme regression surface).
desktop_products_vue captures the Products page after clicking the Vue.js chip: the table filters to 6 rows and the readout recomputes to 'Showing 6 of 24 . Vue.js'.
Source inspection confirms a Hugo + webpack + Tailwind dashboard; the Filter products lever lives in content/crud/products.html, its layout in static/pf.css, and its behavior in static/pf.js.

change_completion: The Products page shows the Filter products chip row with five technology chips and a live 'Showing N of 24 . <Technology>' readout above the 24-row table.
Clicking the Vue.js chip filters the table to 6 rows and updates the readout to 'Showing 6 of 24 . Vue.js'.
The Filter products teaser appears on the Users and Settings pages.
design_consistency: The chip row keeps the Flowbite light theme, blue accent, and sidebar.
The products table stays a tidy legible table with readable row text and active-chip contrast (no overlap, no dark-on-dark).
Desktop and tablet appearance of the chip row and table are preserved.
regression: The sidebar navigation, table actions, and dashboard home remain functional.
No new console errors or failed same-origin network requests are introduced on any captured page.
responsive: At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow or clipped chips.
The products table remains usable on mobile without overlapping rows.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Hugo + webpack + Tailwind admin dashboard (themesberg/flowbite-admin-dashboard; source zip confirmed by exact SHA 229df7ff2580). capability=Add a genre-native Filter products technology filter over the products data table: technology chips + a live 'Showing N of 24' readout + a filtered table, plus a compact teaser on Users and Settings. The three legs vary only in the Filter-products markup in content/crud/products.html, static/pf.css (chip-row responsiveness + table-row layout), static/pf.js (filter wiring), and the per-page presence of the compact teaser on users.html/settings.html. The shared theme, sidebar, table columns, and product data are declared infrastructure, identical across all three legs. As infrastructure (all legs): the products.json technology field is diversified across four technologies, webpack builds in development mode (the production CssMinimizer worker crashes on this Node), the app assets are referenced via Hugo relURL, and the dashboard content-area overflow clamp is relaxed so horizontal overflow is observable at the document level (reference wraps -> 0px). Built with webpack + Hugo; reference is runtime-clean (0 console errors, 0 failed same-origin requests).
